script: if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){async function sniffResource(keywords){const url=new URL('https://www.tvtfun.net/api/videos/search');url.searchParams.set('q',keywords);url.searchParams.set('pageSize',5);const res=await fetch(url.toString(),{method:'GET',credentials:'include',});if(!res.ok){sendResourceList([]);return}const data=await res.json();const resourceList=[];const list=data.data.videos;const origin=document.location.origin;for(const item of list){resourceList.push({id:String(item.id),name:item.name,url:origin+'/video/'+item.slug,img:item.pic,blurb:item.content.split(' ').join(''),})}sendResourceList(resourceList)}function sniffEpisode(){const scripts=document.querySelectorAll('script');let payload=null;for(const s of scripts){const t=s.textContent||'';if(t.includes('playSources')){payload=t;break}}if(!payload){sendSourceMap({});return}const m=payload.match(/self\.__next_f\.push\(\[\d+,\s*'([\s\S]*)'\]\)/);if(!m){sendSourceMap({});return}let jsonStr=JSON.parse('''+m[1]+''');jsonStr=jsonStr.replace(/^[0-9a-f]+:/i,'');let arr;try{arr=JSON.parse(jsonStr)}catch(e){console.error('parse fail',e);sendSourceMap({});return}function findVideo(node){if(!node||typeof node!=='object')return null;if(Array.isArray(node)){for(const item of node){const r=findVideo(item);if(r)return r}return null}if(Array.isArray(node.playSources)&&node.slug)return node;for(const k in node){const r=findVideo(node[k]);if(r)return r}return null}const video=findVideo(arr);if(!video||!video.playSources?.length){sendSourceMap({});return}const sourceMap={};const baseUrl=document.location.origin;const slug=video.slug;video.playSources.forEach((source,sourceIdx)=>{const key=source.name||('线路'+String.fromCharCode(65+sourceIdx));sourceMap[key]=(source.episodes||[]).map((ep,episodeIdx)=>({name:ep.name,url:baseUrl+'/video/'+slug+'/play?source='+sourceIdx+'&episode='+episodeIdx+'&episodeId='+encodeURIComponent(ep.id),}))});sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){const params=new URLSearchParams(document.location.search);const episodeId=params.get('episodeId');if(!episodeId){sendPlayUrl('');return}const origin=document.location.origin;const res=await fetch(origin+'/api/videos/resolve-play-url?episodeId='+encodeURIComponent(episodeId),{method:'GET',credentials:'include',});if(!res.ok){sendPlayUrl('');return}const data=await res.json();if(!data?.data?.url){sendPlayUrl('');return}sendPlayUrl(data.data.url)}window.taskSniffResource=function(keywords){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource(keywords);sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendToFlutter(msg){window.FlutterBridge&&window.FlutterBridge.postMessage(JSON.stringify(msg))}function sniffLog(text){sendToFlutter({msgType:'log',payload:String(text)})}function sendResourceList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'resourceList',payload:list})}function sendEpisodeList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'episodeList',payload:list})}function sendSourceMap(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'sourceMap',payload:map})}function sendPlayUrl(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'playUrl',payload:String(url)})}}else{'undefined'!==typeof sniffLog&&sniffLog('桥接脚本已存在，跳过重复注入')}
